item.title: Best Markdown web clippers for Obsidian, compared (2026)
item.description: MarkDownload was removed from the Chrome Web Store in 2025 and the official Obsidian Web Clipper took the throne. An honest side-by-side of the six tools an Obsidian or Logseq user might pick from in 2026 — including the one I built.
